_about: How a brief is shown to people: <Brand> · <Product> · NNNN (names.brief_label). Brief numbers count per brand and product, so the number alone names several briefs; every label people read carries all three, and every lookup matches the full key <brand>_<product>_brief-NNNN. A product with no short name here is shown from its catalog id (brilliance-body-scrub -> Brilliance body scrub).
_switch: on: false (or BRIEF_IDS_OFF=1 in a machine's environment) puts labels back to 'Brief NNNN' and lets the Studio link and the Queue's done check match by brand + number again. Row in team/rollbacks.md.
